title: the PCSX2 Qt interface advances PS2 preservation
summary: In 2022, the PCSX2 Qt interface became a notable emulation milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2022, the PCSX2 Qt interface became a notable emulation milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
This emulator milestone supports long-term preservation, compatibility research and access to legally owned PS2 software.
